evidence: real HTTP service + headless Chromium browser; no authentication API mocks; not Wails or OS-keyring runtime

coverage.bootstrap: already initialized; supplied password authenticated over real HTTP
coverage.nativeDeviceTransitions: Not exercised: ordinary HTTP browsers cannot enroll or use OS credentials. Native device transitions are covered separately by Go tests, not this browser run; this harness does not run or certify those tests.

nativeHandoff.validTokenLimitation: No native-issued token is available to an ordinary HTTP browser; fabricated tokens are not valid-token evidence.

coverage.loginResponse: Immediate UI reload can evict the login response body in Chromium. Login requires HTTP 200 plus a fresh authenticated session API response and authenticated principal/owner DOM, never visibility or status alone.
coverage.deviceFixtures: none; a nonempty initial device list is rejected
coverage.nativeErrorPresentation: Browser-only production guard invoked directly to inspect its real error presentation; no native transition or OS failure is simulated.
coverage.navigation: 13 canonical sidebar destinations and four aliases at 1440/light/EN and 390/dark/ZH; comprehensive history/font/width matrix remains in the existing navigation harness
coverage.accessibility: Targeted computed sRGB text contrast, semantics, target size/spacing, keyboard/modal, reduced-motion and reflow checks; not a WCAG conformance audit.
coverage.zoom: 200%/400% desktop equivalent: effective layout viewport 720/360 CSS px with Chromium device scale 2/4, verified from innerWidth, DPR and layout; not native browser-menu zoom.
coverage.auxiliaryErrors: Provider/model/network/update reads are diagnostic-only unless authentication, route ownership or tested security UI fails. No provider mutation controls are used; server-side upstream egress is not observable here.
coverage.cleanup: test password restored/preserved; any harness-created viewer removed; recovery verifier intentionally rotated; stop server and discard isolated data
coverage.recoveryProof: management replacement, successful reset, used-code rejection and successful replacement-code reset verified through actual UI; codes never persisted by harness
coverage.otherUserFixture: one disposable local viewer created by real authenticated HTTP; no device fixture
coverage.finalAuthentication: restored password verified by real UI plus HTTP session/owner DOM, then explicitly signed out
